description: Find curated water, environment, terrain and civil engineering source summaries as the recommended starting point for discovery. Understands UK place names and water/civils synonyms; location_hints provide approximate coordinates for live station tools. Unmatched queries return suggestions with a note. Returns paginated summaries (default 20, maximum 50); use get_source for full evidence and enrichment. Query also matches use cases and audience; use_case and audience filters match case-insensitive substrings. Returns separate sponsored and organic arrays plus organic pagination; sponsored placements are pinned and explicitly flagged, and may include coming-soon placeholders. Region includes global sources. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Discovery needs no API key or signup. Open-data router anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session.

audience.description: Case-insensitive substring of the intended audience.

limit.description: Maximum organic summaries per page; default 20, maximum 50.

live_only.description: Only sources queryable through TerraMCP router tools; sponsored placements remain separately labelled.

official.description: Include (default), exclude, or show only government / regulator publishers.

offset.description: Number of organic results to skip for pagination.

query.description: Plain-language source or evidence query; empty to browse. Place hints are approximate, not confirmed site coordinates.

region.description: Region filter; global sources are also included.

sort.description: Default discovery for browsing; Discover keeps text queries ranked by relevance. Quality and Newest explicitly override relevance.

use_case.description: Case-insensitive substring of the source use cases.

name: search_sources
